sharedTokens.note: Alias chain verified byte-for-byte against Variables/Agency/Color Modes.zip → Light Mode (Default).tokens.json on 2026-09-10. The semantic token is the binding; the primitive is its alias target.

field-label.purpose: Label text + optional required marker + optional help icon. The sub-atom every header builds on.

helpIcon.note: positions: label frame ends x=71, help at x=75

field-label.behavior: Static. Help icon opens a tooltip/guidance note on hover/focus (tooltip content is per-form copy, not part of this contract).

field-header-primary.purpose: LEFT/RIGHT split header row for the PRIMARY (view-mode) field: label cluster left, status-icon rail right.

iconSlots.name: ai
iconSlots.note: G / icons for switches in field listing

field-header-primary.behavior: Icons are per-state affordances: error icon appears in error/warning states, help opens guidance, AI marks auto-populated values. Visibility is variant/boolean-driven in usage.

field-header-secondary.purpose: Header for the SECONDARY (edit-mode) field: a field-label instance plus a right-aligned AI icon.
field-header-secondary.behavior: AI icon appears only on AI-assisted fields. Label carries required marker / help via field-label.

field-header-tertiary.purpose: Full vertical info block for the TERTIARY (settings) field: title + description + AI note + error message, sized S/M/L.
field-header-tertiary.typographyDerivation: Title/description styles are DERIVED from row-height ↔ line-height arithmetic (16→caption, 20→body-base, 24→body-strong line heights) plus the styles present in the set's bound variables (Fields/label, Fields/header, Fields/header-large, Body/small, Body/micro). Per-text-node style reads were not taken.
field-header-tertiary.behavior: Required marker sits inline after the title (8×8 icon). AI message and error message rows are optional per state.

field-input.purpose: The shared bordered input control. SECONDARY and TERTIARY molecules embed it; PRIMARY does not (view mode has no input box).

embeddedHeights.note: the secondary molecule instances the input at 30px; the set's own variants are 34px

field-input.statesBindTokens: field/bg-<state> + field/border-<state> exactly as in sharedTokens (danger pair serves the error state). Default border in an editable context is field/border-hard #94a3b8 (kit fix 2026-09-09, live 27062:8093); field/border-default #e2e8f0 is the container/read-only border.
field-input.behavior: Single-line text entry; trailing 30×30 slot hosts pickers/steppers/clear ('Fields Toys' variants — 12 variants not yet enumerated, see notVerified).

field-message.purpose: The message row under a field: icon + short text.
field-message.behavior: One message row per field state; AI row can co-exist with an Error row (tertiary header shows both).

form-section-header.purpose: Section heading for tertiary/settings layouts: title + two-line description on a tinted band.

colour.note: field/value-placeholder is the only secondary text token in this node's bindings

form-section-header.behavior: Static section divider; groups a run of form-field-tertiary rows.

form-field-primary.purpose: Complete VIEW-mode field: grids, tables, list views. Read-first; the value row has no input border of its own — the state colour lives on the container.

geometry.widthRule: 360 is the variant's own width; treat as 100% of parent (pattern-page-form-grid instances it at 254.5px)

states.note: v1.0.0's 'no background' defect is RESOLVED in Figma — field/bg-disabled is now bound on this variant.

form-field-primary.behavior: Display-mode field. Click/focus moves it to an editable context (secondary) in product flows; the AI state marks auto-populated values and pairs with the header's AI icon + an AI field-message.

form-field-secondary.purpose: Complete EDIT-mode field: popups, forms, modals. Header + bordered input + message row on validation states.
form-field-secondary.statesBindTokens: input row binds field/bg-<state> + field/border-<state> (danger pair for error); message row type matches the state.
form-field-secondary.behavior: The editable form control. Message row appears with validation; disabled variant also carries a message slot (76px) in the published set.
form-field-secondary.openQuestion: disabled at 76px implies a message row in disabled state — intended copy for it is unspecified. Flagged, not invented.

form-field-tertiary.purpose: Complete SETTINGS-mode field: horizontal label-block-left / input-right row for settings and configuration panels.
form-field-tertiary.behavior: Settings row; description and messages live in the left block, control on the right. Responsive: blocks stack under narrow widths (Figma shows desktop only — stacking breakpoint UNVERIFIED).
